Content: The AI Memory Suite governance foundation is implemented as warning-first behavior rather than automatic destructive cleanup. MemorySmith:Maintenance:AutomaticDeprecationEnabled defaults false, so low-score records produce DeprecationRecommended events instead of silent Deprecated status moves. A file-backed tag policy lives at Data/Policies/tag-policy.json, and MemoryDiagnosticsService reports tag, source-link, relationship, staleness, and maintenance warnings without changing ranking or the persisted memory schema. Context-pack JSON preserves records/warnings while adding schemaVersion memorysmith.context-pack.v1 and per-record diagnostics. The /memories workbench shows diagnostic chips and a selected-record diagnostics panel. The /tags Tag Manager is the current user-facing policy editor for tag usage, namespaces, allow/block lists, aliases, and suggestions. Roadmap details and unimplemented proposals live in Data/Pages rather than this memory record.
Title: AI Memory Suite Governance Foundation
